title: Interview with Bobby Chiu
content: Bobby Chiu, concept artist and founder of theonline art education site Schoolism, spoke with me this week by phone (since my internet link is too weak for Skype).  (Link to YouTube video)Some of the topics we covered:• How did I learn art before the internet?• The importance of working from memory• How to paint moving subjects• How many hours per day should a young artist draw?• Do you think about brushstrokes when you're painting?• What's the most valuable kind of critique?• How Ray Harryhausen inspired me.• Is computer technology good for artists?• What are the benefits of gouache?• What advice would you give your 20-year-old self?
